snippet.title: Kingdom III: Rising Realms Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4822580/Kingdom_III_Rising_Realms/
A world premiere trailer revealed Kingdom III: Rising Realms, a brand new entry in Raw Fury's beloved series of pixel art strategy games. It's coming soon to PC and consoles.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
